name: tools-golden-egg-0
title: Golden Egg 0.005
description:
Golden Egg is the main editor of Yoshi's Island. It allows object/sprite editing, Header Editor (tileset, music, etc.), palette editor, screen exit editor and much more features.

Note that this tools requires .NET Framework 4 and a Yoshi's Island 1.0 ROM.

Note: this is a WIP tool, therefore, there may be bugs in the Editor.

Also see the Golden egg discussion in http://www.smwcentral.net/?p=viewthread&t=41063
